import pathlib, re
root = pathlib.Path('/workspace/submission/src/de/rub/nds/tlsattacker/core/quic/parser/frame')

# generic: drop the narrowing casts
for p in sorted(root.glob('*.java')):
    s = p.read_text()
    o = s
    s = s.replace('(int) parseVariableLengthInteger()', 'parseVariableLengthInteger()')
    s = s.replace('.getValue().intValue()', '.getValue()')
    if s != o:
        p.write_text(s)
        print('narrowing fixed:', p.name)

# length prefixed reads must be bounds checked
def sub(name, old, new):
    p = root/name
    s = p.read_text()
    assert old in s, (name, old)
    p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
    print('checked:', name)
